load_camera_extrinsics: load camera extrinsics from a text file and return a 4x4 numpy matrix
load_camera_intrinsics: load camera intrinsics from a text file and return focal length, principal point, and baseline
load_depth_map: load a depth map PNG file and return a numpy array of depth values in centimeters
load_semantic_label: load a ground truth semantic segmentation label PNG and return class IDs as a numpy array
create_voxelization_dataset: create a SynthiaVoxelizationDataset with configurable voxel size, augmentation, and data split for 3D semantic segmentation
